explanation: The downstream priority ranks are all 0 because the evidence_sources handoff carries source IDs in the record_id field (s01..s08) instead of the retained demand record IDs (n06-r01..n06-r08). Job 2 received and consumed the two handoffs, but its prioritize function looks up provenance rank by coverage record_id; with the upstream evidence_sources record_id values changed to source IDs, no coverage record matches. The supplied function source localizes this identity corruption to job_1 assemble_provenance, which appends record_id from record.get('source_id') rather than record.get('record_id').
cited_evidence: Job 2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, while Job 2 input needs and coverage contain record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
Observed priorities show upstream_rank: 0 for every record, violating the requirement to preserve upstream provenance order.
assemble_provenance source constructs records with {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, replacing the demand record identity with source_id.
prioritize source builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources record_id and looks up coverage.get('record_id'), so the upstream identity mismatch causes missing ranks.
